text:
Augustus III of Poland bought Correggio's *Penitent Magdalen* (the small "Magdalen Reading" picture) in 1746. It came from the Modena ducal collection and went to Dresden. This corrects my earlier answer, which named the *Madonna of Saint George*. That painting was also part of the 1746 Modena purchase, but I'm going on the team note and my own recall here, not a checked source.

CONFIDENCE: 55
